Q9024.reason: The no-resist statute bars force used to resist the arrest itself, but if the jury believes the suspect the nightstick beating was excessive force and the punch was privileged self-defense even though the arrest was lawful.

Q9025.reason: Zoning compliance is not an absolute defense, and totally blocking an existing solar use when the house could be sited elsewhere is an unreasonable private nuisance, so the categorical judgment for the neighbor should be reversed.

Q9027.reason: Civil law is the body of law that establishes rights between persons and supplies remedies when those rights are violated.
